purpose: Separate whole-column selection, Excel-like Filter control, and dedicated Sort control while keeping Revo Community 4.25.2 native engines intact.

rules.headerBody: Select the clicked column across currently visible rgRow rows only.
rules.filteredSelection: Hidden/trimmed rows are excluded via getVisibleSource(rgRow).
rules.filterButton: Open ERP Excel-like filter UI only; active state is rendered from Revo native hasFilter.
rules.sortScope: Work Order Value, Partial Amount, Remaining Amount, and custom Money only.
rules.history: Each Filter/Sort transition is one Sheet History action; replay is not re-recorded.
rules.dirty: Filter, Sort, and selection are view state and never create Change Engine Dirty/Save deltas.
rules.yearState: Filter/Sort view state is per-year for the current page session; History never crosses a year boundary.

communitySourceReview: sorting.plugin.ts implicit header sort requires column.sortable
sorting.plugin.ts sorts proxy indexes rather than ERP mutating source
filter.plugin.ts owns hasFilter during native filter apply
proArchitectureReference: SortingPlugin remains a separate sorting owner
